classic.note: Classic plus explicitly allow-listed universal production core. Shared ClockSource has its own scope and must not dilute Classic coverage.

clock.note: Shared quarter-note clock infrastructure used by Percussion and Dubstep/Bass is qualified independently from every algorithm bank.

organic.note: Extended-bank release floor: high aggregate decision coverage plus a per-file floor to prevent helpers from masking weak algorithm coverage.

measurement_rules.note: Classic, shared-clock and bank-owned scopes are measured separately. Compiler-generated exception and unreachable branches are excluded so branch coverage tracks executable project decisions rather than toolchain artefacts.

note: Do not lower release coverage floors to accommodate regressions. Add tests or document and exclude genuinely unreachable/generated branches instead.
